create_onnx_object_detection_engine: create an OnnxRuntimeObjectDetectionEngine instance with options, accelerator_options, and model_config for RT-DETR object detection
initialize_onnx_engine: initialize the OnnxRuntimeObjectDetectionEngine session, preprocessor, label mapping, and ONNX runtime providers
run_onnx_inference_batch: run ONNX inference on a batch of images using OnnxRuntimeObjectDetectionEngine.predict_batch and return detection outputs with labels, boxes, and scores
resolve_onnx_model_artifacts: resolve ONNX model artifacts returning the model folder and model path from artifacts_path or HuggingFace download
resolve_onnx_providers: resolve ONNX Runtime execution providers from accelerator options, defaulting to CPU or CUDA depending on device
